newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden Riksbank sets repo rate unchanged 4.10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sweden Riksbank sets repo rate unchanged 4.10 pct.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, on Tuesday set its repo rate at a fixed unchanged 4.10 percent at its weekly operation.
The reverse repurchase operation will run from April 9 to April 16 with bids to be received by 0800 GMT on April 8.
A Reuter poll of 11 economists found none had expected the bank to change the repo rate which is the Riksbank's key tool for controlling money market liquidity.
Most economists surveyed said the volatility of the weak crown would prevent any change to the repo rate.
Five of the economists did not expect any more cuts to the repo rate, which was cut 25 times last year from a starting level of 8.91 percent.
